title: Not planning a music career: bank secretary and the Merry Cottage
summary: Her father wanted her in his business and she had no career plan. She worked as a secretary at a liberal Louisville bank, then loved waitressing at the Merry Cottage, where she arranged flowers and met nice people.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Now, you were saying you never really thought about a career in music.

No I didn't. My father wanted me to stay in the business with him. I hadn't even thought about it. I never really thought about anything then, you know? I hadn't made up my mind what I wanted to be. And the band, I didn't want to stay in that either.
